title: From Free to Paid: Monetizing a Non-Advertising-Based App
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiments (city-level randomization into four pricing and product-design arms). All treated cities switch from free to paid at one launch date; outcomes are cross-sectional user subscription choices. No DiD or event-study design. The 'staggered' text hit refers to peaks in orders (Figure 4), not staggered adoption.
design_notes: JMR 60(4), 2023. Experiment 1: 99 cities randomized in a 2x2 (hard vs soft landing; with vs without exclusive secondary offerings), 80-day run; Experiment 2: 72 cities. User-level subscription choices analyzed with ANOVA, logit, generalized random forests. Plus Prolific survey experiment and a firm-implementation section. No unit panel, no calendar-time fixed effects.
estimators_reported: randomized experiment (ANOVA, logit, generalized random forest)
screener_notes: Not eligible. Single launch date; randomized experiment, not DiD. Data from an app firm in China. No replication package was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only.
